_what_this_is: Machine-readable projection of docs/prereg_tau_harness_2026-09-30.md, in the field layout the ecosystem's load_tau() expects. NOT a new measurement: every number is copied from the pre-registration, which is the authority.
_frozen: 2026-09-30, before any P0 candidate was evaluated under this rule

exact.note: the product is the full float; tau_pp is its 3-decimal rounding because load_tau divides by 100. A future revision must change factor, SE, product and tau_pp together -- the gate re-derives the product and refuses if they disagree.

decision_split: medium (carved from dev by whole case; 88 cases / 440 questions)
accept_rule: delta = decision_value - baseline; keep if delta >= tau. Single metric, single threshold, taken unchanged from agent-jev/scripts/autoresearch_agent.py L391-448.

reproduces.reproduces_previous: 2.14 pp recorded as dev_split_resolution.acc_se_pp, whose source file was absent from the live tree and is therefore re-derivable only from here

not_for.inner_qlora_level: NOT PRE-REGISTERED. QLoRA training is stochastic; its run-to-run dispersion is a property of the training path on this seed and has not been measured with 5 seeds. The 0.40 pp previously in circulation was measured on a retired 322M arm and is VOID (see INSTRUMENT_CALIBRATION._REVOKED_2026-09-30).
not_for.frozen_test_split: V is not read by any measurement behind this threshold. Rule 1 is untouched.
not_for.non_deterministic_harness: a harness stage WITH a fitted stochastic component would need a run-to-run floor of its own; the stages measured here are deterministic and bit-identical across independent evaluations.

revision_policy: tau may be revised only by a new pre-registration stating what was measured and why the measurement changed. It may NOT be revised after seeing which candidates pass.
